appeals.account.queueIntro: Open appeals, oldest first. Overturning undoes what it can: a mature label is removed, a ban or suspension in force is lifted, an account action is reversed.
appeals.account.title: Account actions
appeals.account.intro: Copyright strikes and suspensions recorded on your account. If one is wrong, appeal it and a moderator will review it.
appeals.account.loadFailed: Your account actions could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
appeals.account.emptyHint: Nothing has been recorded against your account.
appeals.account.appealDescription: Tell the moderators why this is wrong. To dispute the removal of the content itself, file a counter-notice under Copyright.
appeals.account.appealFailed: Your appeal could not be sent. Try again.
appeals.account.effect.moderationAction: Overturning lifts the chat ban, timeout or suspension while it is in force. Any other action is recorded only.
appeals.account.effect.reversesStrike: Overturning reverses the strike, and the repeat-infringer suspension if the account drops below the limit.
appeals.account.effect.reversesTerminati: Overturning reverses the termination and lifts the suspension.
appeals.account.effect.accountAction: Overturning reverses the strike or termination. A reversed termination lifts the repeat-infringer suspension.
